summary: BitFuFu Inc., a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin miner, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 unaudited production and operational update via Exhibit 99.1. Metrics: 1,454 BTC held (up 4.8% from 1,388), 137 BTC produced versus 167 in September, hashrate under management 19.5 EH/s, self-owned 3.7 EH/s, fleet efficiency 16.3 J/TH, power capacity 317 MW. The decline is attributed to an approximately 11.8% rise in network difficulty. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; the filing is routine operational disclosure with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
